info.title: GoShorty URL Shortener API
info.description:
REST API for the GoShorty URL shortener (TTL links, custom codes, visits, stats).

The canonical API surface is `/api/v1/*`. Legacy `/api/*` routes remain fully functional as backward-compatible aliases and are marked `deprecated` in this document. The canonical short-link redirect is `/r/:code`; `/s/:code` and `/goshorty/:timeout/:code` are retained so previously issued links keep working.

All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are HMAC-signed payload.signature strings issued by `/api/v1/auth/login` or `/api/v1/auth/register` (see SECURITY.md).
